name: personal-reflector
title_zh: 把情绪卡点拆成可复盘的思维回放
tagline_zh: 焦虑、自我怀疑、关系反复？它不灌鸡汤，只带你回放触发瞬间，看清是旧模式在重播，还是新系统在磨合。
tagline_en: Anxious, doubting, stuck in loops? No platitudes—just replay the trigger moment to see if it's an old pattern or.
desc_en: Use when the user discusses personal emotions, anxiety, self-doubt, behavior patterns, relationships, career identity confusion, or life direction. Triggers on: 焦虑、难受、怀疑自己、模式、重复、关系、职业身份、方向迷茫、转型期、恢复期、意义感、新旧系统交替。
why_zh: 它把情绪当信号而非故障，用「新旧系统交替」视角重审卡点，让每次难受都变成可定位的版本升级日志。
why_en: Treats emotions as signals, not defects—reframes stuck points through a 'system transition' lens, turning each struggle into a.
limit_zh: 只覆盖个人内在议题（情绪/关系/身份），不碰外部决策、技能学习或具体行动方案；产物是认知复盘，不生成安慰话术或心理诊断。
limit_en: Only for inner work (emotions/relationships/identity). No external decisions, skill-building, or action plans. Outputs cognitive replay, not comfort.
